node.title: N=256 E=34 heavy-chord template reduction
node.statement: Every residual N=256, folded-(3,4,0), V=68 collision lies in one of four heavy-position templates: quarter, nonquarter diameter, progression, or generic. Every singleton non-diameter heavy-heavy class contains a heavy-light chord. The quarter template has D_64=16, no light at the missing quarter, and opposite outer heavy signs; its apparent D_64=20 case is impossible.
node.notes: ROUTE REDUCTION 2026-07-27: turns the repeated-chord condition into four exact additive templates and deletes one quarter-diameter branch. It does not exclude the four templates or the residual profile.
